title: Resolution urging Albany to end forced charter school space funding
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass S.423 and S.4449-A. S.423 would repeal the state requirement that New York City pay for or provide space to charter schools, while S.4449-A would make the city eligible for state transitional aid to cover charter school payments. The Council cites that the city paid about $267 million in charter school lease payments in fiscal year 2025.
